newsitem.title: USA: Maine Yankee nuke seen on line in a few days.
newsitem.headline: Maine Yankee nuke seen on line in a few days.

text.p: The 910 megawatt Maine Yankee nuclear power plant in Wiscasset, Maine, is now expected to restart this week, a spokeswoman for the plant said Tuesday.
"We expect to be back on line in the next few days," spokeswoman Maureen Brown said.
The plant was shut late Thursday for electrical repairs.
The company had previously reported the plant would likely restart early Tuesday.
Maine Yankee is 38 percent owned by Central Maine Power Co, 20 percent each by New England Electric System and Northeast Utilities and 22 percent by other New England utilities.
